meta.title: Takshila new site — Amplitude event spec
meta.naming: snake_case, object_action in the past tense (design_prompt_submitted). Properties snake_case. Prices are numbers in major units (620 not 62000) with a separate currency.

priorities.P0: Must ship at launch: the revenue and design-studio funnel. Without these we cannot measure the business.
priorities.P1: Ship at launch if possible: product discovery, community, account, order experience.
priorities.P2: Nice to have: secondary interactions, seasonal campaigns, support content.

user_properties.name: user_role
user_properties.desc: Primary role on the platform. Set on sign-up and when it changes. A user can hold several; send the primary one.

user_properties.name: is_internal
user_properties.desc: True for Takshila staff, designers testing and QA accounts. Lets every chart exclude internal traffic.

user_properties.name: signup_date
user_properties.desc: ISO date the account was created.

user_properties.name: orders_count
user_properties.desc: Lifetime completed orders. Update server-side on order_completed.

user_properties.name: lifetime_revenue
user_properties.desc: Lifetime order revenue in USD. Update server-side on order_completed.

user_properties.name: country
user_properties.desc: Shipping country of the most recent order, or browser country before that.

user_properties.name: marketing_opt_in
user_properties.desc: Subscribed to the newsletter or marketing email.

global_event_properties.name: page_type
global_event_properties.desc: Template of the page the event happened on. Send on every event.

global_event_properties.name: logged_in
global_event_properties.desc: Whether the user is signed in. Send on every event.

events.name: page_view
events.trigger: Every page load and client-side route change.

events.name: nav_clicked
events.trigger: A link in the header nav (SHOP, DESIGN STUDIO, MY ACTIVITY, COMMUNITY, HOW TAKSHILA WORKS) or the footer is clicked.

events.name: cta_clicked
events.trigger: A primary button that is not covered by a more specific event is clicked (START DESIGNING, OPEN DESIGN STUDIO, BROWSE THE SHOP, START YOUR PIECE, EXPLORE COMMUNITY DESIGNS, DESIGN SOMETHING NEW…).

properties.name: section
properties.desc: Section the button sits in, e.g. hero, gift_edit, blank_canvas_banner

events.name: search_opened
events.trigger: The search icon is clicked.

events.name: search_submitted
events.trigger: A search is run.

events.name: upload_design_clicked
events.trigger: UPLOAD DESIGN in the header is clicked.

events.name: prompt_suggestion_clicked
events.trigger: A suggested prompt chip is clicked ("Initial pendant in rose gold", "Oval ring for my mother", "Spider-web pendant"…).

events.name: studio_opened
events.trigger: The Design Studio (or Designer Studio) loads.

properties.name: entry_point
properties.desc: Where they came from: header_nav, home_hero, prompt_chip, community_customise, product_customize, shop_banner, direct

properties.name: is_returning_design
properties.desc: Opened an existing saved design rather than a new one

events.name: studio_step_viewed
events.trigger: The studio advances to a step in the Describe → Direct → Refine → Finalize → Buy stepper. Fire once per step per design.

events.name: design_prompt_submitted
events.trigger: The user clicks Generate, or sends a chat message in the studio. Fire on submit, before the AI responds.

properties.name: prompt_length
properties.desc: Character count. Do not send the prompt text.

properties.name: message_index
properties.desc: 1 for the first brief, 2+ for follow-up chat messages

events.name: design_reference_uploaded
events.trigger: A sketch or photo is attached via "Add a sketch or photo" / UPLOAD.

events.name: design_brief_understood
events.trigger: The AI replies "I have everything I need to start" and shows the brief tags (Ring · Oval diamond · Yellow gold · Hidden halo).

properties.name: clarifying_questions
properties.desc: How many follow-up questions the AI asked before understanding

events.name: design_batch_generated
events.trigger: A set of design directions (Timeless / Modern / Signature) finishes rendering.

properties.name: batch_number
properties.desc: 1 for the first set, 2+ after SHOW 3 NEW DIRECTIONS

properties.name: latency_ms
properties.desc: Time from prompt submit to render

events.name: design_generation_failed
events.trigger: Generation errors or times out.

events.name: design_directions_regenerated
events.trigger: SHOW 3 NEW DIRECTIONS or a modifier chip (Simpler, Bolder, More vintage, More classic, Something else…) is clicked.

events.name: design_direction_chosen
events.trigger: CHOOSE THIS DIRECTION is clicked.

events.name: design_version_created
events.trigger: A new version (v2, v3…) is generated from a change the user asked for in Refine.

properties.name: change_area
properties.desc: If the AI can classify the request

events.name: design_version_restored
events.trigger: The user taps an earlier version to go back to it.

events.name: design_named
events.trigger: NAME IT is confirmed.

events.name: design_finalize_started
events.trigger: FINALIZE MATERIALS is clicked.

events.name: saved_designs_opened
events.trigger: The saved-designs drawer is expanded, or a saved design is opened from it.

events.name: studio_exited
events.trigger: The studio exit (X) is clicked. Shows where people abandon.

events.name: design_posted_to_community
events.trigger: A design is shared to the Community feed.

events.name: product_list_viewed
events.trigger: A product grid or rail scrolls into view (once per list per page view).

properties.name: list_name
properties.desc: shop_all, shop_by_category, halloween_picks, gift_edit, first_fine_jewelry, engagement, you_might_also_like, made_for_you

events.name: product_list_filtered
events.trigger: A category tile, filter or tab (For Her / For Him, SOLITAIRE / TOI ET MOI) changes the product list.

events.name: product_clicked
events.trigger: A product card (image, name or CUSTOMIZE) is clicked.

events.name: product_viewed
events.trigger: A product page loads.

properties.name: product_type_slug
properties.desc: ring, necklace, earrings, bracelet, pendant, cufflinks, wedding_band, set

properties.name: designer_id
properties.desc: Designer credited on the page, if any

events.name: product_option_selected
events.trigger: A configurable option changes: metal, karat, gold colour, ring size, length, centre stone, carat, shape, quality, side stones.

properties.name: product_id
properties.desc: Product slug, or design_id in the studio

events.name: price_breakdown_viewed
events.trigger: View price breakdown / Price breakdown is opened. The site's transparency promise ("Every dollar, on the receipt").

events.name: product_info_opened
events.trigger: PRODUCT JOURNEY, RETURN POLICY, "See how big they look", "See where each length sits" or similar info panels are opened.

events.name: delivery_estimate_checked
events.trigger: A ZIP code is entered and Check is clicked.

events.name: size_guide_opened
events.trigger: Find your ring size / Find your bracelet length / Size guide is opened.

events.name: size_guide_method_selected
events.trigger: A sizing path is chosen.

events.name: wishlist_item_added
events.trigger: Save to wishlist / heart is turned on.

events.name: wishlist_item_removed
events.page: Product cards, product pages, My Activity › Wishlist
events.trigger: A saved item is un-saved.

events.name: content_shared
events.trigger: Share is clicked on a product, community post or design.

events.name: cart_item_added
events.trigger: Add to cart or Add set is clicked.

events.name: buy_now_clicked
events.trigger: BUY NOW is clicked.

properties.name: product_id
properties.desc: Product slug, or design_id in the studio

properties.name: financing_shown
properties.desc: Whether the monthly-payment option was displayed

events.name: cart_viewed
events.trigger: The bag opens.

events.name: cart_item_removed
events.trigger: Remove is clicked, or quantity goes to 0.

events.name: checkout_started
events.trigger: The checkout page loads with at least one item. Replaces design_checkout_started, which only covered the studio.

events.name: checkout_step_completed
events.trigger: A checkout section is completed and validated.

events.name: delivery_option_selected
events.trigger: A delivery option is chosen.

events.name: promo_code_applied
events.trigger: APPLY is clicked on a gift card or promo code (fire for success and failure).

properties.name: code
properties.desc: Campaign codes only (e.g. SPELL13). Hash or omit unique gift-card numbers.

events.name: gift_options_set
events.trigger: Gifting is turned on or the gift note is saved.

events.name: progress_updates_opted_in
events.trigger: "Text and email me progress photos" is ticked.

events.name: payment_started
events.trigger: CONTINUE TO PAYMENT is clicked.

events.name: order_completed
events.trigger: Payment succeeds. Send from the server once per order, with revenue, so Amplitude revenue charts work.

events.name: payment_failed
events.trigger: A payment attempt is declined or errors.

events.name: activity_tab_viewed
events.trigger: A My Activity tab is opened.

events.name: order_tracking_expanded
events.trigger: An order card is expanded.

events.name: order_stage_details_viewed
events.trigger: A production stage (Idea, Design, CAD, Gemstone, Crafting, Certified, Delivered) is opened.

events.name: cad_review_opened
events.trigger: REVIEW CAD is clicked on an order that needs approval.

events.name: cad_approved
events.trigger: The customer approves the CAD (production can start).

properties.name: hours_to_approve
properties.desc: Hours since the CAD was sent

events.name: cad_changes_requested
events.trigger: The customer asks for changes to the CAD.

events.name: message_sent
events.trigger: A message is sent via Message the studio / MESSAGE ABOUT THIS ORDER.

events.name: order_document_downloaded
events.trigger: An invoice or certificate is downloaded.

events.name: order_payment_retry_clicked
events.trigger: A failed payment is retried.

events.name: activity_design_edited
events.trigger: A saved design is reopened for editing.

events.name: activity_design_removed
events.trigger: A saved design is deleted.

events.name: activity_community_status_toggled
events.trigger: A saved design is made public or private.

events.name: community_feed_viewed
events.trigger: The feed loads or a feed tab is switched.

events.name: community_filter_applied
events.trigger: A category (Rings, Earrings…) or content filter (Designed in the studio, Behind the bench, Worn by you) is chosen.

events.name: community_post_opened
events.trigger: A post is opened.

events.name: community_like_toggled
events.trigger: A post is liked or unliked.

events.name: community_design_customised
events.trigger: CUSTOMISE is clicked on a community post: the community-to-studio handoff.

events.name: community_post_created
events.trigger: SHARE YOUR WORK / Share something is published.

events.name: user_followed
events.trigger: FOLLOW is clicked (fire unfollow with following=false).

events.name: profile_viewed
events.trigger: A profile page loads.

events.name: profile_tab_viewed
events.trigger: Feed / Salon / Store / About tab is opened.

events.name: profile_edit_saved
events.trigger: Profile edits are saved.

events.name: profile_share_clicked
events.trigger: SHARE / Share profile is clicked.

events.name: referral_link_shared
events.trigger: SHARE AND EARN / a referral link is copied or shared.

events.name: sign_up
events.trigger: An account is created. Call setUserId at the same moment.

properties.name: trigger_point
properties.desc: What prompted it: studio_save, checkout, community_like, header

events.name: login
events.trigger: A user signs in.

events.name: newsletter_signed_up
events.page: Footer "Takshila in your mailbox" on every page
events.trigger: Subscribe succeeds with a valid email. Never send the email.

events.name: designer_cta_clicked
events.trigger: A supply-side CTA is clicked: OPEN DESIGNER STUDIO, SELL YOUR DESIGNS, APPLY AS A MAKER, MAKE WITH US, "Designing to earn?".

events.name: designer_design_published
events.trigger: A designer publishes a design for sale.

events.name: contact_form_submitted
events.trigger: SEND MESSAGE succeeds.

events.name: faq_opened
events.trigger: A FAQ question is expanded.

events.name: process_stage_viewed
events.trigger: A stage in the 01 Idea → 07 Delivered explainer is clicked.

events.name: campaign_interacted
events.trigger: An interactive seasonal element is used (Halloween lights switch, Pick a pumpkin).

deprecated.name: design_category_selected
deprecated.reason: The new studio is prompt-first; there is no category picker. The product type now comes from design_brief_understood.product_type_slug.

deprecated.name: design_checkout_started
deprecated.reason: Replaced by checkout_started with source = buy_now_studio, which also covers shop purchases.

deprecated.name: design_localized
deprecated.reason: Replaced by design_version_created (each requested change creates a new version).

deprecated.name: design_tab_switched
deprecated.reason: The new studio uses a step flow; replaced by studio_step_viewed.

deprecated.name: community_rated
deprecated.reason: The new design has likes, no ratings.
